how-it-works.title: Good work starts with a clear plan.
how-it-works.intro: From the first search to the final review, keep your home service in one place with SerbisyoGo.

sections.title: Find a local professional
sections.body: Explore service categories, compare profiles and read feedback from completed bookings. Identity and skills badges describe different document reviews.

sections.title: Describe the task and choose a time
sections.body: Select a service, explain what needs attention and request an available appointment. For quotation-based work, accept the provider’s final quotation before confirming.

sections.title: Agree on the details
sections.body: Your provider accepts the request. Use the booking conversation to confirm access, scope, materials and any changes before work starts.

sections.title: Follow the appointment
sections.body: See booking status updates. Live location is available only during eligible active jobs when the assigned provider chooses to share it.

sections.title: Check the work and payment record
sections.body: Review the completed job and invoice. Follow the payment options shown in your booking; a service request does not automatically charge you.

sections.title: Leave useful feedback
sections.body: After completion, the booking customer can submit a review. If something needs attention, open a support case with the booking details.

for-clients.title: A helping hand for the home you care for.
for-clients.intro: Choose a professional, make the scope clear and keep the details of your next home service together.

sections.title: Compare before you book
sections.body: Browse local services, starting rates, service areas and customer reviews. Open a profile to see its services and available appointment slots.

sections.title: Understand the badges
sections.body: Identity reviewed means an administrator reviewed a government ID. A skills badge means a separate trade or professional credential was reviewed. Neither badge guarantees the result of a job.

sections.title: Keep the price clear
sections.body: Review labor, the booking fee and the total before confirming. Estimated services require an accepted quotation. Agree on materials and extra work in the booking conversation.

sections.title: Keep a record
sections.body: Messages, booking updates, the invoice and your review stay connected to the job. Submit payment references or receipts only through the controls available in your booking.

sections.title: Get help with a concern
sections.body: Use Help & support to open a case, describe what happened and attach relevant evidence. Support replies appear in the case thread.

for-workers.title: Bring your skills closer to home.
for-workers.intro: Build a service profile for your community, set your availability and manage requests with SerbisyoGo.

sections.title: Tell clients about your work
sections.body: Create an account and submit a provider profile with your specialty, experience, city and service areas.

sections.title: Choose one accepted document
sections.body: Upload at least one accepted ID or credential for administrative review. You do not need every document listed. Extra certificates and portfolio evidence are optional.

sections.title: Build trust with specific evidence
sections.body: An administrator may separately review a government ID for an identity badge and a trade or professional credential for a skills badge. Uploading a file does not automatically award a badge or approve your profile.

sections.title: List services and working hours
sections.body: Add at least one active service with a clear rate and duration, then set your weekly availability. Your application stays pending until an administrator approves it.

sections.title: Manage your requests
sections.body: Review incoming bookings, accept work that fits your schedule and discuss the scope in the booking conversation. Keep job status updates accurate.

sections.title: Complete work and build your reputation
sections.body: Mark completed work correctly, keep payment records accurate and let completed-booking reviews show clients what to expect.

faq.title: A little clarity goes a long way.
faq.intro: Answers about getting started, booking a service, provider documents, payments and support.

contact.title: Let’s get you to the right help.
contact.intro: A booking concern, an account question or a document review: start with the route that keeps your information in the right place.

sections.title: An existing booking
sections.body: Open the booking conversation to discuss scope or scheduling with your provider. For a dispute or safety concern, open a support case linked to that booking.

sections.title: Account or application help
sections.body: Sign in and open Help & support. Include a clear description and any relevant booking reference. Never send your password, GCash PIN or one-time codes.

sections.title: Private documents
sections.body: Upload verification documents from your provider workspace. They are available to you and authorized administrators, rather than published on your public profile.

faq.question: What does SerbisyoGo do?
faq.answer: SerbisyoGo connects clients with local home service providers. You can compare services, request an appointment, exchange booking messages and keep service records together.

faq.question: Can I use the website and Android app with one account?
faq.answer: Yes. Your account connects to the same service on the website and Android app. Download the published APK from the official SerbisyoGo download page.

faq.question: How do I request a service?
faq.answer: Find a professional, choose an active service, describe the task and select an available appointment. Review the address and price before submitting the request. The provider must accept it.

faq.question: Is the displayed estimate the final price?
faq.answer: For quotation-based services, the provider supplies a final labor quotation that you must accept before confirmation. Review the booking fee and total, and discuss any materials or changes before work starts.

faq.question: Can I track my provider?
faq.answer: Eligible active bookings can show live location when the assigned provider enables location sharing. Location is not continuously available and arrival estimates are not guaranteed.

faq.question: Do workers need to upload every document?
faq.answer: No. One accepted ID or credential is sufficient for submission readiness. Extra documents are optional. An administrator still reviews the application; active services and weekly availability are also required before approval.

faq.question: What does Identity reviewed mean?
faq.answer: An administrator reviewed a government ID submitted by that provider. It does not mean a TESDA certificate or trade qualification was reviewed.

faq.question: What does a skills badge mean?
faq.answer: An administrator separately reviewed a trade or professional credential. The label identifies its type, such as TESDA NC II or a PRC credential. A government ID alone does not award a skills badge.

faq.question: Are identity and skills documents both mandatory?
faq.answer: No. The one-document application rule remains. Identity and skills badges are optional, separate reviews of the relevant documents. A provider can have one, both or neither badge after application approval.

faq.question: Does requesting a booking charge me automatically?
faq.answer: No. Follow the payment instructions available in your booking. SerbisyoGo currently uses cash or administrator-reviewed manual payment records; an automatic payment gateway is not connected.

faq.question: How does GCash work?
faq.answer: GCash instructions appear only when an administrator has verified and enabled the recipient. If available, check the recipient and amount, then submit the reference or receipt through your booking. Uploading a receipt alone does not mark the payment as paid.

faq.question: Who can see uploaded IDs and certificates?
faq.answer: Verification files are private to their owner and authorized administrators. Public profiles show only approved badge summaries, not the documents, document numbers or reviewer details.

faq.question: How do I report a problem?
faq.answer: Open Help & support, select the booking if relevant and describe your concern. You can attach evidence after creating the case and read replies in its thread.

faq.question: Can I cancel or get help with a payment dispute?
faq.answer: Cancellation options depend on the booking status. Open the booking to check available actions. For payment disputes, submit a support case so an administrator can review the job, messages and payment records. A refund is not automatic.
